marks.gloss_en: מחמיר אני בחלב מבדם -- one who milks for healing, [the milk] is impure; one who lets blood for healing, [the blood] is pure

the Sages (אמרו לו): סלי זיתים וענבים יוכיחו -- the liquids from them are impure when willed and pure when unwilled (= p_salim_leratzon); a liquid can render susceptible only when willed, so animal milk may be such a liquid. Unanswered.
the Sages: baskets of olives and grapes will prove it -- the liquids coming from them willed are impure, unwilled are pure
olives and grapes, which are made for squeezing -- unwilled [seepage] is nothing; mulberries and pomegranates, not made for squeezing, all the more so
(entertained) 'willed' is where he is pleased; 'unwilled' is where he expressed nothing
לא: 'willed' is the unspecified case and 'unwilled' is where he said 'I do not want it' -- the baskets say nothing about the unspecified case
ואיבעית אימא: baskets of olives and grapes are different -- their liquid stands to be lost, so he renounces it from the outset
לא: 'unwilled' is where he revealed his mind -- 'I do not want it' (= p_shelo_leratzon_gilui_daat)
ואיבעית אימא: the baskets are different -- liquid standing to be lost he renounces from the outset (= p_salim_leibud_mafkir)
no: 'willed' includes the unspecified; 'unwilled' is where he revealed his mind, saying 'I do not want it'
אשכחן רבי יהודה דמודי לרבנן בזיתים ובענבים -- from the baraita's olives and grapes clause
רבנן דמודו ליה לרבי יהודה בשאר פירות מנלן? דתניא: סוחטין בפגעין ובפרישין ובעוזרדין, אבל לא ברמונים
